argv:
from pathlib import Path
from copy import deepcopy
import importlib.util,json
path=Path('../checks/tools/check_first_turn.py').resolve()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('current_first_turn_check',path)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
native=module.load_native()
assert callable(native.verify_export) and callable(native.public_view_bytes)
episode={'train':[{'input':[[1]],'output':[[8]]},{'input':[[2]],'output':[[8]]}],'test':[{'input':[[color]],'output':[[8]]} for color in (3,4,5,6)],'seed':17,'settings':{'mode':'synthetic'}}
visible=native.public_view_bytes(episode,0)
variants=list(module.first_turn_variants(episode))
assert len(variants)==6
for name,variant in variants:assert native.public_view_bytes(variant,0)==visible,name
changed=deepcopy(episode)
changed['test'][0]['input'][0][0]=7
assert native.public_view_bytes(changed,0)!=visible
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','synthetic_only':True,'mutation_checks':len(variants),'positive_controls':1,'native_bundle_verification':'not_run','racket_executed':False}))
